ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) distribution across approximately 92% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and in discrete circular ring structures.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark field covering the medial and central lobe regions; high-contrast white geometric clusters at the extreme lateral distal tips (left and right); scattered mid-intensity circular ring outlines distributed across the mid-to-outer lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 70 degrees at the vertex joining the two fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged serrations visible along the entire trailing perimeter; pixel-level amplitude variations range from 3 to 10 pixels in depth relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Smoothly convex sweep starting from the median notch, transitioning into an upward-curving parabolic arc toward the acuminate distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white circular clusters at both lateral extremities; multiple isolated low-contrast circular rings (diameters 10-25 pixels) distributed symmetrically across the lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the extreme lateral tips; multiple circular scars consistent with parasitic or predatory interactions scattered across the fluke surface.
